texts.konto.karta.opis: Without an account everything works on this computer and nothing is sent. An account gives you online results, friends and the ranking. Each person can have their own account or none.
texts.konto.co_wysylamy: The server gets: the e-mail, username and sessions of the person the account belongs to (date, steps, distance, moving time, treadmill model, game name if it is shown). It does not get: names of people, settings, colours and simulator sessions.
texts.konto.kod_opis: You can create an account only with an invitation code. Someone who already has an account can give you one.
texts.konto.nowa_osoba_opis: The account will be a new person in the app, with the same name as the username.
texts.konto.pseudonim_zasady: Username: 3–24 characters, letters, digits, space, underscore, hyphen and full stop. Do not enter your full name.
texts.konto.haslo_zasady: Password: at least {liczba} {liczba, plural, one {character} other {characters}}.
texts.konto.zapamietaj_opis: The password is not saved. Windows keeps only a sign-in key.
texts.konto.regulamin_zgoda: I accept the terms and the privacy policy
texts.konto.regulamin_czytaj: Read the terms and the privacy policy
texts.konto.link.mam_konto: Already have an account? Sign in
texts.konto.rejestracja.gotowe: Account created. Open the e-mail from WalkLevel and click the confirmation link (check spam too). Until then online features do not work.
texts.konto.reset.opis: You will get a link to set a new password at your address. The link works for 30 minutes. After the password change you need to sign in again on every computer.
texts.konto.reset.wyslano: If an account with this address exists, an e-mail with a link will come to it. Check spam too.
texts.konto.blad.hasla_rozne: The passwords differ. Enter the same password in both fields.
texts.konto.blad.regulamin: Accept the terms to create an account.
texts.konto.wygaslo: The sign-in of {osoba} has expired or the password was changed. Sign in again in Settings > Account and people.
texts.konto.przypiete: This account already belongs to {osoba} on this computer. Switch to that person.
texts.konto.email.niepotwierdzony: The e-mail address is not confirmed. Without it you cannot recover your password.
texts.konto.email.wyslano_toast: A confirmation link is on its way to {email}. Click it in the message (check spam too).
texts.konto.email.wyslano: Confirmation link sent. Check your inbox.
texts.konto.email.juz: The e-mail address is already confirmed.
texts.konto.regulamin.zmiana_opis: Read the changes and accept them to use the new features: results split by game, and levels and achievements visible to friends. Until then sessions are sent as before, without game names and mode.
texts.znajomi.moj_profil: My profile as others see it
texts.znajomi.pusto: Your friends list is empty. Invite someone by username, or give a new account code to someone who has no account.
texts.znajomi.idzie: walking now {kmh} km/h · {kroki} {kroki, plural, one {step} other {steps}}
texts.znajomi.dodaj_opis: Enter the username of a person who has an account. That person must accept the invitation.
texts.znajomi.wyslane: Sent invitations waiting for a reply
texts.znajomi.przyjeto: {pseudonim} is now on your friends list.
texts.znajomi.kod.opis: For someone without an account: a code to enter when creating the account. That person goes straight to your friends list.
texts.znajomi.kod.zasady: The code works once, for 14 days.
texts.ranking.pusto: No one has results in this period yet.
texts.ranking.opis.poziomy: The level ranking counts kilometres since the account was created. This week counts from Monday, this month from the 1st (Polish time).
texts.ranking.opis.zasady: The ranking counts sessions on a real treadmill that are visible to friends or everyone. Hidden sessions and profiles are not counted.
texts.osoby_online.pusto: No one has this username. Check the spelling.

texts.osoby_online.opis: The list shows only people who show their profile to everyone. No one sees e-mail addresses.
texts.moje.wyniki.wysylaj_opis: Every 2 minutes and after each session.
texts.moje.wyniki.jedna_sesja: You can hide a single session in Step history > session details. It then stays only on this computer.
texts.moje.profil.tytul: My profile as others see it
texts.moje.gry.kto: Who sees my results for each game
texts.moje.gry.opis: Others see your total steps, and after a click also your results for each game. You can hide a single game in Settings > Games and controls > Game profiles > (profile) > Show this game on the online account.
texts.moje.haslo.rozne: The new passwords differ. Enter the same one in both fields.
texts.moje.haslo.opis: After a password change, other computers will be signed out.
texts.moje.haslo.zmienione: Password changed. Other computers have been signed out.
texts.moje.konto.zapamietaj_wyl: When this is off, closing WalkLevel signs you out of the account.
texts.moje.konto.pobierz: Download my data from the server
texts.moje.konto.pobrano: Your data from the server is saved in {plik}.
texts.moje.konto.usun_opis: Deleting the account removes it from the server together with your results and friends. Results on this computer stay. Enter your password and hold the button.
texts.moje.konto.usun_brak_hasla: Enter your password to delete the account.
texts.profil_online.moj_opis: This is how others see your profile. You choose who sees it in the My account tab.

texts.profil_online.moje_ukryte: Hidden sessions (“Only me”) do not count in the results others see.
texts.profil_online.cudze_ukryte: You see only the sessions this person shows you.

texts.levels.rank.1.name: Hobbit of the Shire
texts.levels.rank.1.about: Six meals a day leave a hobbit little time for long walks.
texts.levels.rank.2.name: Pac-Man
texts.levels.rank.2.about: On every level of the 1980 arcade game, he goes round the same maze.
texts.levels.rank.3.name: Ori
texts.levels.rank.3.about: The storm blew him off the Spirit Tree like a leaf.
texts.levels.rank.4.name: The Nameless Hero
texts.levels.rank.4.about: His whole world fitted under the Barrier, about 2 km across.
texts.levels.rank.5.name: Baron Harkonnen
texts.levels.rank.5.about: Suspensors and ornithopters carry him around Arrakis, so he seldom walks on his own two feet.
texts.levels.rank.6.name: Chell
texts.levels.rank.6.about: She completed every test chamber at Aperture Science, then escaped through the facility’s maintenance areas.
texts.levels.rank.7.name: V of Night City
texts.levels.rank.7.about: V gets around Night City, from Watson to Santo Domingo, mostly by car.
texts.levels.rank.9.name: Gordon Freeman
texts.levels.rank.9.about: Crowbar in hand, he fought his way through Black Mesa, from the site of the accident to the portal to Xen.
texts.levels.rank.10.name: The Chosen Undead
texts.levels.rank.10.about: To ring both bells, he went from the church at the top of Lordran all the way down to the swamp at the bottom.
texts.levels.rank.12.name: The Marked One
texts.levels.rank.12.about: From the Cordon he crossed the whole Zone to the Power Plant.
texts.levels.rank.13.name: The Hero of Kvatch
texts.levels.rank.13.about: He started in a cell under the Imperial City and closed his first Oblivion Gate at Kvatch.
texts.levels.rank.15.name: Kyle Crane
texts.levels.rank.15.about: He got around Harran mostly over the rooftops, because the streets were full of the infected.
texts.levels.rank.17.name: Dragonborn
texts.levels.rank.17.about: He could fast travel, but some cave always turns up along the way.
texts.levels.rank.19.name: Link
texts.levels.rank.19.about: Looking for 120 shrines, he crossed Hyrule from the Great Plateau to the farthest mountains.
texts.levels.rank.21.name: Minsc and Boo
texts.levels.rank.21.about: Together they crossed the Sword Coast in the first Baldur’s Gate and Amn in the second.
texts.levels.rank.23.name: Master Chief
texts.levels.rank.23.about: From the lifeboat to the Library, he covered a good stretch of the Halo ring.
texts.levels.rank.26.name: The Lone Wanderer
texts.levels.rank.26.about: He took his first steps outside Vault 101, blinded by a sun he had never seen before.
texts.levels.rank.31.name: Arthur Morgan
texts.levels.rank.31.about: He sketched the gang’s journey from snowbound Colter to Saint Denis in his journal.
texts.levels.rank.35.name: The Courier of the Mojave
texts.levels.rank.35.about: After being shot in the head, he crossed the desert from Goodsprings to Hoover Dam.
texts.levels.rank.40.name: Rincewind
texts.levels.rank.40.about: With Twoflower and the Luggage, he fled Ankh-Morpork all the way to the Rim of the Disc.
texts.levels.rank.44.name: Mario
texts.levels.rank.44.about: In the first Super Mario Bros., he went through 32 levels, from 1-1 to 8-4, to rescue the princess.
texts.levels.rank.48.name: Ash Ketchum
texts.levels.rank.48.about: With Pikachu, he travelled from region to region until he became the Alola League Champion.
texts.levels.rank.52.name: Lara Croft
texts.levels.rank.52.about: She searched for tombs on every continent, usually on foot and with a rope.
texts.levels.rank.55.name: Nathan Drake
texts.levels.rank.55.about: He hunted for treasure from Borneo to Madagascar.
texts.levels.rank.59.name: Kratos
texts.levels.rank.59.about: With his son, he carried his wife’s ashes across Midgard to the highest peak in all the realms.
texts.levels.rank.62.name: Geralt of Rivia
texts.levels.rank.62.about: He is not actually from Rivia, but he knows the roads of the Continent from Kaer Morhen to Toussaint.
texts.levels.rank.65.name: Aloy
texts.levels.rank.65.about: She crossed the whole Forbidden West on foot, from the deserts to the ruins by the ocean.
texts.levels.rank.69.name: Ellie
texts.levels.rank.69.about: From Boston, she walked west across the ruined United States.
texts.levels.rank.72.name: Arya Stark
texts.levels.rank.72.about: From King’s Landing, she crossed the whole of the Riverlands, then reached Braavos and came back.
texts.levels.rank.75.name: Arthas
texts.levels.rank.75.about: He went all the way to the glaciers of Northrend for a cursed sword.
texts.levels.rank.78.name: Paul Atreides
texts.levels.rank.78.about: He fled Arrakeen into the deep desert, then crossed all of Arrakis with the Fremen.
texts.levels.rank.81.name: Ciri
texts.levels.rank.81.about: Fleeing the Wild Hunt, she kept landing in worlds with no easy way back.
texts.levels.rank.84.name: Duncan Idaho
texts.levels.rank.84.about: The Swordmaster of House Atreides spent long months in the desert with the Fremen.
texts.levels.rank.87.name: Bilbo Baggins
texts.levels.rank.87.about: With thirteen dwarves, he went from Bag End to the Lonely Mountain, there and back again.
texts.levels.rank.89.name: Frodo Baggins
texts.levels.rank.89.about: It took him half a year to walk from the Shire to Mount Doom.
texts.levels.rank.92.name: Sam Porter Bridges
texts.levels.rank.92.about: He connected America on foot, coast to coast.
texts.levels.rank.95.name: Odysseus
texts.levels.rank.95.about: It took him ten years to get home to Ithaca.
texts.levels.rank.97.name: Roland Deschain
texts.levels.rank.97.about: He followed the man in black across the desert, then crossed Mid-World to the Dark Tower.
texts.levels.rank.100.name: The Grey Pilgrim
texts.levels.rank.100.about: He wandered Middle-earth for two thousand years.
texts.levels.achievement.km1.name: Tutorial Complete
texts.levels.achievement.km1.flavor: The character walked the first kilometre and the tutorial disappeared from the screen.
texts.levels.achievement.km2.name: Beyond the Barrier
texts.levels.achievement.km2.flavor: According to the game’s description, the magic barrier over the Colony in Gothic is a sphere two kilometres across. This is from wall to wall.
texts.levels.achievement.km57.name: Skyrim on Foot
texts.levels.achievement.km57.flavor: That is roughly how wide the in-game map of Skyrim is from west to east. A whole province, at the game’s scale, crossed on foot.
texts.levels.achievement.km113.name: Diagonally Across Erangel
texts.levels.achievement.km113.flavor: The Erangel map in PUBG is 8 by 8 km, so corner to corner is over 11 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km212.name: Chernarus, Corner to Corner
texts.levels.achievement.km212.flavor: Chernarus in DayZ covers 225 km², or 15 by 15 km. Corner to corner, that comes to over 21 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km24.name: Nether Shortcut
texts.levels.achievement.km24.flavor: In Minecraft’s Nether every block counts as eight. There, these 24 km are only 3,000 blocks.
texts.levels.achievement.km30.name: Through the Zone
texts.levels.achievement.km30.flavor: The Zone in S.T.A.L.K.E.R. is an area around a power plant with a radius of about 30 km. From the Cordon in the south to the Power Plant itself.
texts.levels.achievement.km447.name: The Citadel, End to End
texts.levels.achievement.km447.flavor: The Citadel station in Mass Effect is 44.7 km long, end to end.
texts.levels.achievement.km53.name: Chilkoot Pass
texts.levels.achievement.km53.flavor: Buck from London’s “The Call of the Wild” takes the trail over Chilkoot Pass towards the Klondike. From Dyea to Lake Bennett it is 53 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km63.name: The Edge of Valheim
texts.levels.achievement.km63.flavor: The world of Valheim is a disc with a radius of 10 km. All the way round, along the very edge, it comes to almost 63 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km70.name: Tsushima, North to South
texts.levels.achievement.km70.flavor: Tsushima Island, where Ghost of Tsushima is set, is about 70 km from north to south in real life.
texts.levels.achievement.km805.name: By Elephant to Allahabad
texts.levels.achievement.km805.flavor: In “Around the World in Eighty Days”, 50 miles of railway are missing between Kholby and Allahabad. Phileas Fogg crosses that gap on the back of an elephant.
texts.levels.achievement.km100.name: Silver Jogger
texts.levels.achievement.km100.flavor: The silver Jogger medal in Pokémon GO takes 100 km walked with a phone in your pocket.
texts.levels.achievement.km115.name: Bucklebury Ferry
texts.levels.achievement.km115.flavor: On Frodo’s road: the ferry across the Brandywine on the eastern edge of the Shire.
texts.levels.achievement.km160.name: Straight Through the Death Star
texts.levels.achievement.km160.flavor: The first Death Star was 160 km across. That is the distance from pole to pole.
texts.levels.achievement.km200.name: Carthag to Arrakeen
texts.levels.achievement.km200.flavor: That is the distance between two cities of Arrakis in “Dune”. The Fremen would walk it without rhythm so as not to attract a worm.
texts.levels.achievement.km215.name: The Prancing Pony
texts.levels.achievement.km215.flavor: On Frodo’s road: the inn at Bree, beyond the borders of the Shire.
texts.levels.achievement.km246.name: Athens to Sparta
texts.levels.achievement.km246.flavor: According to Herodotus’ “Histories”, the messenger Pheidippides ran from Athens to Sparta in two days. The Spartathlon on this route is 246 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km318.name: Across the Halo
texts.levels.achievement.km318.flavor: The Halo ring is 318 km wide. This is from one wall to the other.
texts.levels.achievement.km385.name: Weathertop
texts.levels.achievement.km385.flavor: On Frodo’s road: a ruined watchtower on a lonely hill by the Great East Road.
texts.levels.achievement.km420.name: Togo’s Longest Leg
texts.levels.achievement.km420.flavor: In the 1925 serum run to Nome, the team led by the dog Togo covered 261 miles, about 420 km. It was the longest leg of the whole relay.
texts.levels.achievement.km483.name: Patrolling the Wall
texts.levels.achievement.km483.flavor: The Wall closes off the north of Westeros from sea to sea. You have patrolled its whole length.
texts.levels.achievement.km583.name: The Appian Way to Brindisi
texts.levels.achievement.km583.flavor: Sienkiewicz set the “Quo vadis, Domine?” scene on the Appian Way. According to Britannica, the road ran 132 miles to Capua and 230 more beyond, about 583 km in all.
texts.levels.achievement.km640.name: St. Olav’s Way
texts.levels.achievement.km640.flavor: The pilgrim route from Oslo to Nidaros Cathedral in Trondheim, where King Olaf was buried, is about 640 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km737.name: To Rivendell
texts.levels.achievement.km737.flavor: That is how far the hobbits walked from Hobbiton to the House of Elrond, with the Nazgûl on their heels.
texts.levels.achievement.km800.name: Fetching Pathfinder
texts.levels.achievement.km800.flavor: Watney from “The Martian” drives a rover to fetch the old Pathfinder probe. According to NASA, the Ares 3 landing site lies about 800 km north of it.
texts.levels.achievement.km950.name: Boston to Pittsburgh
texts.levels.achievement.km950.flavor: Joel and Ellie’s first big stretch in The Last of Us, along overgrown highways.
texts.levels.achievement.km1009.name: The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry
texts.levels.achievement.km1009.flavor: In Rachel Joyce’s novel, retired Harold Fry goes out to post a letter and keeps on walking, from Kingsbridge to Berwick-upon-Tweed. That is 627 miles, about 1,009 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km1085.name: Serum for Nome
texts.levels.achievement.km1085.flavor: In 1925 a relay of dog sled teams carried serum from Nenana to Nome: 674 miles, about 1,085 km, in five and a half days. Balto led the last leg.
texts.levels.achievement.km1190.name: The Pass of Caradhras
texts.levels.achievement.km1190.flavor: On the Fellowship’s road: the snowy pass that would not let them through the mountains.
texts.levels.achievement.km1257.name: Around the Mun
texts.levels.achievement.km1257.flavor: The Mun in Kerbal Space Program has a radius of 200 km. You have gone round it without a rocket.
texts.levels.achievement.km1285.name: The Doors of Durin
texts.levels.achievement.km1285.flavor: From Rivendell to the western wall of Moria, through the snows of Caradhras.
texts.levels.achievement.km1407.name: Land’s End to John o’ Groats
texts.levels.achievement.km1407.flavor: The classic walk across the whole of Great Britain, from a headland in Cornwall to the northern tip of Scotland. By road it is traditionally 874 miles, or 1,407 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km1480.name: Lothlórien
texts.levels.achievement.km1480.flavor: On the Fellowship’s road: the golden wood of the Elves by the Silverlode, where winter never seems to come.
texts.levels.achievement.km1609.name: The Ringworld’s Rim Wall
texts.levels.achievement.km1609.flavor: The walls along the edges of the Ringworld in Niven’s novel are about 1,000 miles high. That is the distance straight up, if you could walk them.
texts.levels.achievement.km1697.name: Tōkai Nature Trail
texts.levels.achievement.km1697.flavor: Japan’s Tōkai Nature Trail runs through the mountains from Takao near Tokyo to Minoh near Osaka. According to the Tokyo government, it is 1,697 km long.
texts.levels.achievement.km1770.name: Wild
texts.levels.achievement.km1770.flavor: In “Wild”, Cheryl Strayed describes how she walked 1,100 miles of the Pacific Crest Trail alone. That is about 1,770 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km1854.name: Daymar’s Equator
texts.levels.achievement.km1854.flavor: Daymar, a moon of the gas giant Crusader in Star Citizen, has a radius of 295 km in the game. Its equator is about 1,854 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km1935.name: The Rapids of Sarn Gebir
texts.levels.achievement.km1935.flavor: On the Fellowship’s road: rocky rapids on the Anduin, where the boats have to be carried along the bank.
texts.levels.achievement.km2000.name: Via Francigena
texts.levels.achievement.km2000.flavor: Archbishop Sigeric described the pilgrim route from Canterbury to Rome in 990. According to guidebooks, today’s route is about 2,000 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km2105.name: The Falls of Rauros
texts.levels.achievement.km2105.flavor: The great falls on the Anduin, which the Fellowship reached in elven boats.
texts.levels.achievement.km2220.name: Down from the Emyn Muil
texts.levels.achievement.km2220.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: after a few days lost among the rocks, the climb down the cliff on an elven rope.
texts.levels.achievement.km2300.name: The Great Barrier Reef
texts.levels.achievement.km2300.flavor: The reef where Nemo lives in the Pixar film stretches along the coast of Australia for over 2,300 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km2360.name: The Dead Marshes
texts.levels.achievement.km2360.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: marshes full of lights you must not follow.
texts.levels.achievement.km2414.name: Along the Rabbit-Proof Fence
texts.levels.achievement.km2414.flavor: In the film “Rabbit-Proof Fence”, three girls run away from a settlement and walk home along the fence for nine weeks. That is 1,500 miles, about 2,414 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km2480.name: The Black Gate
texts.levels.achievement.km2480.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: the closed gate of Mordor.
texts.levels.achievement.km2540.name: Ithilien
texts.levels.achievement.km2540.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: a green, herb-scented land of Gondor just below the mountains of Mordor.
texts.levels.achievement.km2650.name: The Stairs of Cirith Ungol
texts.levels.achievement.km2650.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: winding stairs cut into the rocks of the Ephel Dúath.
texts.levels.achievement.km2700.name: By Camel to the Ocean
texts.levels.achievement.km2700.flavor: Robyn Davidson, whose trek is shown in the film “Tracks”, crossed the Australian deserts with camels from Alice Springs to the Indian Ocean, about 2,700 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km2762.name: Omsk
texts.levels.achievement.km2762.flavor: According to Verne, Omsk lies roughly halfway along the route of the Czar’s courier from Moscow to Irkutsk.
texts.levels.achievement.km2865.name: One Does Simply Walk into Mordor
texts.levels.achievement.km2865.flavor: Frodo and Sam’s whole road from the Shire to the slopes of Mount Doom.
texts.levels.achievement.km3058.name: Pony Express
texts.levels.achievement.km3058.flavor: In 1860, riders carried the mail from St. Joseph to Sacramento in ten days. The route was about 1,900 miles, or 3,058 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km3235.name: To Schiaparelli Crater
texts.levels.achievement.km3235.flavor: That is how far Mark Watney from “The Martian” drove a rover across Mars to get home.
texts.levels.achievement.km3490.name: The Oregon Trail
texts.levels.achievement.km3490.flavor: The historic Oregon Trail, followed by the game The Oregon Trail, was about 2,170 miles long. People crossed the prairie by wagon and on foot.
texts.levels.achievement.km3940.name: Route 66
texts.levels.achievement.km3940.flavor: Steinbeck called it the Mother Road in “The Grapes of Wrath”. The whole of Route 66, from Chicago to Santa Monica, was 2,448 miles, or 3,940 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km4023.name: Twenty-Five Hundred Miles
texts.levels.achievement.km4023.flavor: In “The Call of the Wild”, Buck’s team covered 2,500 miles in less than five months, about 4,023 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km4500.name: Delivery Complete
texts.levels.achievement.km4500.flavor: That is roughly the size of America in Death Stranding, from the east coast to the west.
texts.levels.achievement.km4800.name: From the Wall to Dorne
texts.levels.achievement.km4800.flavor: Westeros from the Wall to the southern coast of Dorne, about 3,000 miles on the scale of the maps where the Wall is 300 miles long.
texts.levels.achievement.km5523.name: Courier of the Czar
texts.levels.achievement.km5523.flavor: Michael Strogoff’s route in Verne’s novel: 5,200 versts from Moscow to Irkutsk across the whole of Siberia.
texts.levels.achievement.km6128.name: To the Heart of Arrakis
texts.levels.achievement.km6128.flavor: According to “The Dune Encyclopedia”, the radius of Arrakis is 6,128 km. That is how far the sand is from the centre of the planet.
texts.levels.achievement.km6500.name: From the Gulag to India
texts.levels.achievement.km6500.flavor: Sławomir Rawicz described an escape from a Gulag camp in Siberia and a march all the way to India, about 6,500 km. The truth of his account is now disputed.
texts.levels.achievement.km7200.name: Across Hoth
texts.levels.achievement.km7200.flavor: The ice planet from Star Wars is 7,200 km across. This takes you straight through it, knee-deep in snow.
texts.levels.achievement.km8047.name: Hub to Rim
texts.levels.achievement.km8047.flavor: Pratchett’s Discworld is about 10,000 miles across. This takes you from the Hub all the way to the Rimfall.
texts.levels.achievement.km9656.name: The Length of Brobdingnag
texts.levels.achievement.km9656.flavor: According to Swift, the land of giants in “Gulliver’s Travels” is about 6,000 miles long. That is 9,656 km.
texts.levels.achievement.km10000.name: Platinum Jogger
texts.levels.achievement.km10000.flavor: The highest tier of the Jogger medal in Pokémon GO: 10,000 km on foot.
texts.levels.achievement.s3.name: First Checkpoint
texts.levels.achievement.s10.name: One More Turn
texts.levels.achievement.s10.flavor: A well-known problem of strategy gamers has moved to the treadmill.
texts.levels.achievement.s21.name: One Life, One Run
texts.levels.achievement.s21.flavor: A roguelike run: from start to finish with no saves.
texts.levels.achievement.d7.name: The 7,000 Steps
texts.levels.achievement.d7.flavor: That is how many steps lead up the Throat of the World to High Hrothgar.
texts.levels.achievement.d12.name: Grinding Day
texts.levels.achievement.d12.flavor: Your step counter clocked up as much today as some people do in a week.
texts.levels.achievement.d20.name: Difficulty: Nightmare
texts.levels.achievement.d20.flavor: The highest difficulty in daily mode. Few people pick it.
texts.levels.achievement.seria3.name: Dawn of the Final Day
texts.levels.achievement.seria3.flavor: In Majora’s Mask, Termina has three days before the Moon falls on it. Your streak survived a full cycle.
texts.levels.achievement.seria3.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 3 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
texts.levels.achievement.seria7.name: Horde Night
texts.levels.achievement.seria7.flavor: In 7 Days to Die a horde comes every seventh night. Your streak lasted until the first one.
texts.levels.achievement.seria7.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 7 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
texts.levels.achievement.seria28.name: A Full Season
texts.levels.achievement.seria28.flavor: A season in Stardew Valley lasts 28 days. Your streak lasted a whole one, from the first day to the last.
texts.levels.achievement.seria28.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 28 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
texts.levels.achievement.seria80.name: Around the World in 80 Days
texts.levels.achievement.seria80.flavor: Phileas Fogg in Verne’s “Around the World in Eighty Days” went round the world in 80 days. Your streak has lasted as long.
texts.levels.achievement.seria80.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 80 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
texts.levels.achievement.seria365.name: A Year on the Island
texts.levels.achievement.seria365.flavor: In Animal Crossing time follows the real calendar, so a full year on the island really takes a year.
texts.levels.achievement.seria365.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 365 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
texts.levels.achievement.gra1.name: New Game
texts.levels.achievement.gra1.flavor: For the first time, the character in this game walks with your legs.
texts.levels.achievement.gra1.condition: Play your first session in a game profile.
texts.levels.achievement.gry3.name: Three Worlds
texts.levels.achievement.gry3.flavor: The characters change, the sore legs stay the same.
texts.levels.achievement.gry3.condition: Walk 10 km in each of 3 different games.
texts.levels.achievement.gry5.name: Interdimensional Tourist
texts.levels.achievement.gry5.flavor: Five worlds now bear your footprints.
texts.levels.achievement.gry5.condition: Walk 10 km in each of 5 different games.
texts.levels.achievement.gra100.name: My Main
texts.levels.achievement.gra100.flavor: The rest of your library is getting jealous.
texts.levels.achievement.gra1000.name: I Live Here Now
texts.levels.achievement.gra1000.flavor: The guards in this game know you by name.
texts.levels.achievement.trening.name: Training Mode
texts.levels.achievement.trening.flavor: As in fighting games: training first, then real fights.
texts.levels.achievement.trening.condition: Finish your first session in Training mode.
texts.levels.achievement.rano.name: First on the Server
texts.levels.achievement.rano.flavor: A session before seven, and the server is still empty.
texts.levels.achievement.noc.name: Late-Night Grind
texts.levels.achievement.noc.flavor: One more kilometre and then bed. Definitely.
texts.levels.achievement.znajomy.name: Party +1
texts.levels.achievement.znajomy.flavor: Your first companion has joined the party.
texts.levels.achievement.polecenie.name: Recruiter
texts.levels.achievement.polecenie.flavor: Someone created an account from your invitation, and the party grew.
texts.levels.achievement.polecenie.condition: Someone creates an account using your code.
